parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the time range to query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and UTC time is used. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the API group.

parameters.name: StageName
parameters.description:
The environment in which you want to perform the query. Valid values:

*   **RELEASE**: the production environment
*   **PRE**: the staging environment
*   **TEST**: the test environment

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the time range to query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and UTC time is used. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-group-latency --start-time 2023-03-30T16:00:00Z --end-time 2023-04-14T06:26:14Z --stage-name RELEASE --group-id d825094fdd114a869f5adb443d9b7ead --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi DescribeGroupLatency --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime '2023-04-14T06:26:14Z' --StageName RELEASE --StartTime '2023-03-30T16:00:00Z' --GroupId d825094fdd114a869f5adb443d9b7ead
